Alibaba prices? Yes. Wondering if my shades are currently lost somewhere in the Pacific Ocean? Maybe not yet. If international shipping/customs is the part making you nervous about ordering from Alibaba, try filtering your search by U.S. Stock first. There are WAY more products already sitting in U.S. warehouses than I expected! cabinets, furniture, vanities, building materials and more. Just remember: U.S. Stock doesn’t mean you stop asking questions. Confirm your exact item + quantity are actually in the U.S., where they’re shipping from, domestic freight cost and delivery time before paying. Basically… Alibaba with training wheels. 😂 #buyfromchina #alibaba #customhome #BuildingAHouse #homebuildingtips
